turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
es it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

03:01 PM

I know waiting on tracking can be frustrating 😊 Normally, orders placed before 11 AM EST are processed the same business day, and orders placed after 11 AM EST are processed the following business day. Once your order is dispatched, you’ll receive a shipping confirmation email with your tracking link. Standard orders can take up to 10 days for processing and shipping, and delivery typically takes 5 to 10 business days.

turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail:
y tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?

03:04 PM

I’m sorry that happened. If your tracking shows delivered but you do not have the package, please first check whether a neighbor, roommate, or doorman accepted it, confirm the shipping address is correct, contact the carrier for any extra delivery details, and look around any discreet delivery spots. Please also allow 2 business days after the marked delivery date, as packages can sometimes show up shortly after 😊
